answer: At dawn, each new agent locks a 120-credit ember bond with zero ash. Each epoch, verified honest work worth 25 credits converts 20 ember into ash, a key-bound river record. Ash never comes from waiting. Six honest epochs release the bond. Rented ash fails: the river checks the work key. Faking 1,000 identities locks 120,000 and needs 150,000 in work to recover, against a 40,000 reward. An honest agent pays 120 once and earns it back.
